We are seeking an ambitious, self-directed Sales Manager to accelerate revenue growth across the Americas and advance the digitization of the global weather and climate ecosystem. Operating with the autonomy of a regional owner, you will expand Spire’s market presence across key industry segments, leverage our partner ecosystem to drive adoption of our forecast data, APIs, and decision-support solutions, and consistently exceed sales targets.
Two segments sit at the center of this territory. The first is the financial sector — energy and commodity trading desks, hedge funds, and quantitative investment firms that treat weather as a tradable signal and buy differentiated data to sharpen their edge.

The second is the U.S. electric utility and power market: the investor-owned utilities, public power authorities, independent power producers, and grid operators who generate electricity and keep the grid balanced, and for whom forecast accuracy translates directly into load planning, renewable generation, outage response, and reliability.
This is a high-impact, quota-carrying role for a seller who is energized by how data and software are reshaping traditional industries — and who wants to sell a product that is, quite literally, powered by space.

Own a territory: Build and execute a territory plan spanning the Americas — from Canada and the United States through Mexico, Central America, the Caribbean, and South America— identifying and developing new business opportunities while growing and retaining existing client accounts.
Lead with our priority segments: Drive growth in the financial sector — engaging traders, portfolio managers, quantitative researchers, and heads of data at trading houses, hedge funds, and asset managers — and across U.S. utilities, IPPs, and grid operators, where you will position Spire’s forecasts against load forecasting, renewable generation, and grid reliability use cases.
Exceed targets: Meet and surpass assigned quotas through disciplined prospecting, qualification, and full-cycle deal execution.
Build lasting relationships: Develop strong, long-term relationships with key clients, partners, and stakeholders across the weather, climate, and earth intelligence ecosystem — understanding their needs, challenges, and objectives to tailor solutions accordingly.
Sell consultatively: Use a solution-selling approach to uncover clients’ operational pain points and propose tailored offerings built on Spire’s weather forecasts, historical data, and climate analytics.
Master the product: Develop deep expertise in Spire’s data products and platforms — their features, differentiation, and applications — to communicate compelling value to technical and executive audiences alike.
Deliver winning proposals: Prepare and present persuasive sales presentations, proposals, and responses to tenders that clearly articulate Spire’s value proposition.
Negotiate and close: Lead commercial negotiations on terms and pricing to reach mutually beneficial agreements and close deals reliably.
Manage your pipeline: Maintain an accurate, up-to-date pipeline in our CRM, ensuring rigorous forecasting and timely follow-up on every lead and opportunity.
Know the market: Track industry trends, competitive movements, and emerging opportunities across your regions to inform strategy and identify new areas for growth.
Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner with marketing, product, meteorology, and customer success teams to ensure client satisfaction and feed market insight back into product development.

8+ years of experience in sales, business development, or account management, with a focus on selling data products, SaaS, or API-based solutions.
A demonstrated track record of consistently meeting or exceeding sales targets and quotas.
Strong understanding of the weather and climate industry, or deep experience selling digital transformation into data-driven sectors such as financial markets, power and energy, maritime, aviation, agriculture, or logistics.
Proven success selling data, analytics, or alternative data into the financial sector — commodity, power, or weather derivatives trading desks, hedge funds, or quantitative funds — with the credibility to hold a technical conversation with traders, quants, and research leads and to navigate data-procurement and evaluation processes.
Experience selling into United States electric utilities, independent power producers, or grid operators — with a working understanding of how weather drives generation, load
forecasting, renewable integration, outage and storm response, and grid reliability, and of how utility and public-power procurement cycles work.
A consultative, value-based selling style with excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
Proven ability to build and maintain trusted client relationships across cultures, time zones, and seniority levels.
Proficiency with modern sales tools (e.g., Salesforce or similar CRM, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Lusha).
Self-motivated, results-oriented, and effective working independently in a remote, globally distributed team.
Fluent in English; willingness to travel across the territory as needed.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience, preferably in a high-tech field.
Legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future visa sponsorship.

Additional language skills relevant to the Americas — Spanish, Portuguese, or French — are a strong plus, though not required.
An existing network within meteorology, earth observation, or climate-tech communities.
Familiarity with U.S. power market structure and the ISOs/RTOs — PJM, ERCOT, MISO, CAISO, SPP, NYISO, ISO-NE — or with FERC and NERC reliability requirements.
An established network on trading floors or among alternative-data buyers at hedge funds and quantitative investment firms.
Experience selling to or partnering with government agencies, national met services, or large enterprises in regulated industries.
Why Spire?
Mission with impact: help organizations worldwide adapt to a changing climate using data collected from space.
Real ownership: a large, high-potential territory with the autonomy to build it your way.
Competitive compensation: base salary plus uncapped commission, and equity participation.
Flexible, remote-first working within a collaborative, international team spanning four continents.

About Fresha
Fresha is the AI-powered operating system for the global beauty, wellness and self-care industry, connecting and powering everything from salons and barbers to spas, medspas, fitness studios and health practices.
Trusted by millions of consumers and businesses worldwide. Fresha is used by 140,000+ businesses and 450,000+ stylists and professionals worldwide, processing over 1 billion appointments to date.
The company is headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with 15 global offices located across North America, EMEA and APAC.
Fresha allows consumers to discover, book and pay for beauty and wellness appointments with local businesses via its marketplace, while beauty and wellness businesses and professionals use an all-in-one platform to manage their entire operations with an intuitive business software and financial technology solutions.
Fresha ’s ecosystem gives merchants everything they need to run their business seamlessly by facilitating appointment bookings, point-of-sale, customer records management, marketing automation, loyalty, beauty products inventory and team management.
The consumer marketplace unlocks revenue potential for partner businesses by leveraging the power of online bookings and automated marketing through mobile apps and advanced integrations with major tech brands including Instagram, Facebook and Google.

Given our exciting and progressive growth plans, we are looking for an exceptional Business Development Manager to join our global business.
Reporting directly to the General Manager of Southern Europe and working collaboratively with the Commercial team and strategic partners, you will be 100% focused on driving new business growth and expanding Fresha 's presence across the region.

The Key Account Manager l is responsible for driving sales growth and profitability across the designated accounts on Mass Market and Hobby Retail channel in France, Belgium & Netherlands. This role will develop strong customer relationships, manage complex commercial negotiations, and deliver sustainable long-term growth within the French, Belgium & Netherlands hobby and collectibles retail sector.
The position requires strong commercial acumen, deep understanding of the French, Belgium and Netherlands retail landscape, and the ability to navigate both traditional and modern trade environments. Collaboration with internal teams and external distributors will be key to delivering execution excellence and achieving category leadership. This is a full time role, in the designated office 5 days per week.

Manage and grow sales performance across the designated accounts in in France, Belgium & Netherlands ensuring delivery against sales, margin, and profitability targets.
Develop account-specific strategies that align with brand and category objectives across key partners and independents.
Lead the onboarding of new distributors, hobby and specialist accounts, identifying opportunities that drive incremental growth and brand visibility.
Conduct market analysis to understand category trends, competitor performance, and consumer behaviour, informing account planning and channel strategy.
Build and maintain long-term relationships with retailers and distributors, acting as the primary commercial contact for negotiations, promotions, and planning of the designated accounts.
Partner with internal teams (Marketing, Brand, Planning, Logistics, Finance) to deliver seamless customer execution and exceptional service.
Provide accurate sales forecasts, performance reports, and insights to senior management.
Implement joint business plans and promotional activations, maximising retail impact and consumer engagement.
Represent the company and its brands at trade fairs, hobby events, and industry meetings in France and across Europe when required.
Knowledge / Skills / Experience
Minimum 5–7 years of experience in Key Account Management or Sales, ideally within Hobby, Toy, Game, or FMCG sectors.
Proven success in managing major French, Belgium and Netherlands retail accounts and delivering consistent sales growth.
Strong knowledge of the French, Belgium and Netherlands retail environment, distribution models, and buyer negotiation processes.
Experience with collectibles, trading cards, or hobby channels is highly desirable.
Excellent commercial and financial acumen, with solid understanding of pricing, margins, and forecasting.
Fluent in French and English (both written and spoken). Dutch will be a good plus.
Strong communication and presentation skills, capable of influencing at senior levels.
Organised, proactive, and able to manage multiple priorities autonomously.
Adaptable and resilient, with a hands-on approach and entrepreneurial mindset.

Blend360 is looking for a senior Client Partner to own and grow a strategic, established account in the Technology, Media & Telecom (TMT) space — with a specific focus in the telecommunications and ISP market. This is a high-impact role for someone who brings executive presence, deep sector knowledge, and a genuine passion for turning data, analytics, and AI into measurable client outcomes.
You will serve as the primary relationship owner and growth driver for a large, active account — bringing together the right Blend360 talent, capabilities, and offerings to help the client solve complex business challenges and unlock new opportunities.

Own the full account — strategy, growth execution, and P&L — with a mandate to expand the relationship and deepen Blend360's footprint within the client organization.
Identify and close new business opportunities across the client portfolio; develop and deliver compelling pitches, proposals, and Statements of Work (SOW) that speak to the client's strategic priorities.
Negotiate pricing and engagement structures that deliver strong value for the client while achieving healthy margins for Blend360.
Drive overall client satisfaction by anticipating needs, resolving issues proactively, and consistently delivering on commitments.
Connect decision makers at the client with the right Blend360 capabilities, practice leaders, and talent to address their most important data, analytics, and technology challenges.
Act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders — from VP to C-suite — across technology, marketing, operations, and finance functions.
Represent the voice of the client internally, ensuring Blend360's delivery teams understand the business context and are set up to succeed.
Industry Expertise
10+ years of experience in client management or business development within data-driven marketing, analytics, or data services — with a minimum of 5 years focused on the TMT sector.
Deep understanding of the telecommunications and ISP landscape: familiarity with the competitive dynamics, customer lifecycle challenges, network operations, and digital transformation pressures facing Tier 1 and Tier 2 telcos and ISPs.
Established network of senior relationships across telecom and ISP organizations — you know how these companies buy, who the decision makers are, and how to navigate complex, matrixed procurement environments.
Fluency in the data and analytics use cases most relevant to telecom and ISP clients: churn reduction, customer lifetime value modeling, network analytics, revenue assurance, personalization at scale, and AI-driven customer experience.
Consulting & Client Management Background
Big 4 or top-tier management consulting background (or equivalent) strongly preferred. Experience in a consulting environment shapes the structured problem-solving approach, executive communication style, and commercial discipline this role demands.
Proven track record of growing accounts — not just retaining them. You have a history of expanding scope, introducing new capabilities, and converting relationships into revenue.
Ability to partner effectively with Capability and Practice Leaders to shape solutions and close new business. You are a connector as much as a closer.
Experienced at building business cases and ROI narratives that resonate with data-driven and finance-oriented stakeholders.
How You Work
You have the 'driver' gene — proactive, energized by building relationships, and relentless in pursuing new opportunities across the client organization.
Passionate about the intersection of data, analytics, and technology — and genuinely excited to bring those capabilities to bear on clients' most pressing challenges.
Executive-level presentation and communication skills; you are as comfortable in a boardroom as you are in a working session with an analytics team.
Creative, resourceful, solutions-oriented, and highly organized. You manage ambiguity well and keep multiple workstreams moving simultaneously.
Collaborative and flexible — you know how to bring internal teams along without losing momentum.
Willing and able to travel to client locations as the engagement requires.
